items.text: ENVIRONMENTAL PROBLEMS ASSOCIATED WITH THE BURNING OF FOSSIL FUELS FROM CRUDE OIL

items.label: text
items.text: There are major environmental problems associated with the burning of fossil fuels derived from crude oil. First of all, the carbon dioxide produced when hydrocarbons are burned is a greenhouse gas. Greenhouse gases trap the heat radiated from the Earth's surface (originally from the Sun) and many people believe that this could lead to climate change. For more discussion on the greenhouse effect, see Chapter 13.
